intervalMethod: member-clustered Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap within cohort strata; percentile interval
bootstrapDrawAlgorithm: For zero-based replicate b, lexicographically sorted cohort stratum h with n_h >= 2 members, and zero-based draw d in 0..n_h-2, SHA-256(UTF8(seed + NUL + b + NUL + h + NUL + d)); interpret digest bytes 0..7 as unsigned big-endian 64-bit integer and select index modulo the lexicographically sorted member count n_h. Draw exactly n_h - 1 members with replacement. Member i receives factor m_hi * n_h / (n_h - 1), m_hi its multiplicity. n_h counts every cohort member in the stratum, including members with no drawn unit. A stratum with n_h = 1 keeps factor 1 in every replicate. Reuse the resulting factors for every metric of both arms in that replicate.
controlWeight: member cohort weight from draw.json; the weights over all cohort members must sum to estimandTotal, and the estimator fails closed on mismatch
caseWeight: 1 for a discordant (census) unit; N_s / taken_s for a concordant stratum, taken_s the units drawn in it
unitWeight: controlWeight(member) * caseWeight * bootstrap factor(member); the factor is 1 at the point estimate
caseSamplingStratum: rule * concordant class (C/C, N/N, X/X) for sampled units; rule * paired class (for example CORE-A3-DOCKERFILE-NO-HEALTHCHECK|N/C) for the census; every unit's caseStratum must equal ruleId|classV17/classV23 and every census unit must carry caseWeight 1, or the estimator fails closed

unitClassScoring.countedWhen: the arm's own class is C, N or X; a unit whose class is NA in an arm is not counted by that arm

present.X: false negative in the headline recall; excluded from recallExcludingX

unitClassScoring.insufficient-context: excluded from both denominators; counted in the insufficient-context share
unitClassScoring.withheld-evidence: excluded from both denominators; counted in the abstention share

metrics.recall: TP / (TP + FN), present-labelled class X counted as FN
metrics.recallExcludingX: TP / (TP + FN) with present-labelled class X units excluded; published beside recall
metrics.abstentionShare: design-weighted share of the arm's counted headline units labelled withheld-evidence or of class X; reported, gates nothing, never omitted

pairedDifference: v23 - v17 for precision and for recall (headline); both arms computed on the same replicate factors inside every replicate; interval is the type-7 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of the per-replicate differences; arms are never bootstrapped separately
undefinedFigurePolicy: a figure whose denominator is zero, or whose interval has fewer valid replicates than minimumValidReplicateShare requires, is null with a stated reason, never 0
missingRulePolicyDetail: Per rule, for both arms: a rule leaves a metric's headline only when it has no labelled in-population unit counted by that metric's denominator in either arm, and then it leaves both arms' headline for that metric and is reported separately. An arm that emits nothing on a rule with present-labelled units keeps the rule and scores those units as misses. Precision's denominator counts class C units labelled present or absent; recall's counts present-labelled units of class C, N or X.

controlInsufficientContext.aggregateComputedOver: per arm, design-weighted insufficient-context units over that arm's counted units in the headline (voided strata removed); a tripped arm's headline precision, recall and recallExcludingX are null with a stated reason, and both paired differences are null
controlInsufficientContext.rationale: Cycle-12 estimation protocol section 3, decided: the ceilings carry forward as-is because they are adjudicability gates, not a function of the candidate population that shifted between fork-era and pin-truth scans. Never re-derived from expected or observed labels.

perCaseStratumSmallStratumFloor.decidedOption: cycle-12-estimation-protocol.md section 3, forced amendment, option (a), applied to every cycle-13 case stratum (operator ruling 3, 2026-10-01)
perCaseStratumSmallStratumFloor.rule: A case stratum (caseSamplingStratum, census included) voids when insufficientContextCount >= minimumInsufficientContextCount AND (insufficientContextCount / n) > maximumShare, where n is the units drawn in it. Labels are arm-independent, so a voided stratum leaves both arms' headline and is reported separately, never pooled.
perCaseStratumSmallStratumFloor.equivalentForm: Algebraically identical to insufficientContextCount > max(1, maximumShare * n) for every integer n >= 1 and every integer 0 <= insufficientContextCount <= n, including every boundary where maximumShare * n lands on an integer.
perCaseStratumSmallStratumFloor.singletonStratumLimit: For n = 1 this floor is inert by construction: minimumInsufficientContextCount (2) can never be satisfied by a stratum of size 1, so the per-stratum floor mathematically cannot fire on a singleton. The aggregate maximumAggregateDesignWeightedShare ceiling above is the only guard on singleton strata. This is a documented limit of the floor, stated here rather than discovered later — not a bug to fix by changing the formula.

completedLabelSeal: sealed/labels-sha256.json must exactly bind sealed/completed-review.csv and the review hash manifest, including external negative-control artifacts, before key access or scoring
implementationSeal: cohort hashes.json must bind every tracked file under (private record) plus root/workspace/package manifests, lockfile, and TypeScript configuration; scanning and scoring both require and record the exact out-of-band SHA-256 of hashes.json recorded after metadata freeze; repository paths resolve from the Git top-level so the seal is package-cwd and squash/rebase safe; both fail closed on mismatch
checkoutFileBoundary: tracked non-symlink regular files whose canonical paths remain inside the immutable checkout
crossWaveAggregation: pool weighted record contributions across completed waves before each bootstrap replicate

validityForPromotion: Protocol section 6, read as signed: only a tripped aggregate insufficient-context ceiling voids an arm's headline, and a voided headline fails promotion-policy P0 for that arm. A voided case stratum or an excluded rule leaves the headline and is reported separately; neither by itself makes the estimate invalid. Seal fields carried from v3 (completedLabelSeal, implementationSeal, crossWaveAggregation) bind cycle 13 as written; the packet and seal card satisfies them or a signed amendment changes them before any label.

declaredLimitations.singletonCohortStrata: Operator, 2026-10-01, option 1 of the (private record) review: a cohort stratum with one member keeps factor 1 in every replicate and adds no variance, so intervals understate uncertainty by that stratum's share. Accepted and declared, not corrected. Every estimate reports the singleton strata count and their design-weight share beside each interval. Measured on the cycle-13 draw before any label: 2 of 33 strata, 4 of 3,163 weight (0.13%); one of the two (weight 1) has every eligible repository drawn and so has no sampling variance; the other (weight 3, 0.09%) is the only understatement.
